source: 922 A102 legacy_three_band_gamma_plus records in canonical order
logical_result: For every finite catalogue record, D(s)>0 and N_{j+1}(s) is strictly increasing on the closed source segment. Therefore the sign of N_{j+1} at the lower endpoint completely determines whether this target condition has exactly one zero before the strict witness (negative lower sign) or no zero on the segment (positive lower sign). This statement concerns the target condition only; it does not by itself prove that no other KKT condition becomes a boundary.
nonclaims: does not classify the full KKT atlas for all 922 records
does not prove non-target KKT positivity for all 922
